summary: Backend-only testing for Android location permission fix. Verified: (1) @capacitor/geolocation ^8.2.2 in package.json, (2) ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION & ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION in AndroidManifest.xml, (3) POST /api/user/{id}/update-location accepts lat/lng/location & persists, (4) GET /api/discover/{id} returns profiles and distance_km when GPS coords set, (5) city=Mumbai and city=Delhi filters correctly return only matching profiles, (6) /api/health OK. All 7 pytest tests pass (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: update_location endpoint does not validate that user exists (no 404 on unknown user_id) — silently succeeds with matched_count=0. Consider returning 404 if update_one matched_count == 0.
server.py is ~7663 lines — should be split into feature modules for maintainability.
City filter uses regex on 'location' field which stores 'City, State' — works but could match substrings across state names; consider anchored regex or dedicated 'city' field.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user cca39b3f-9f7e-485d-9ae3-d6b210d424fb; updated its location to Mumbai coords during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Location + city discover backend fully verified. Android GPS runtime cannot be tested in preview — file-level verification only. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_location_discover.py.
